question: What attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs through enjoyment and liberation?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are conjoined as a goal
A great accomplishment is the subject
This accomplishment can make one dear to the yoginīs
inference: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: The great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may make one dear to the yoginīs.
